tool_input.command:
cat >> db/schema.ts <<'EOF'

export const apiTokens = sqliteTable('api_tokens', {
  id: text('id').primaryKey(),
  name: text('name').notNull(),
  hashedToken: text('hashed_token').notNull().unique(),
  userId: integer('user_id')
    .notNull()
    .references(() => users.id),
  abilities: text('abilities', { mode: 'json' }).$type<string[]>().notNull(),
  lastUsedAt: integer('last_used_at', { mode: 'timestamp_ms' }),
  expiresAt: integer('expires_at', { mode: 'timestamp_ms' }),
  createdAt: integer('created_at', { mode: 'timestamp_ms' }).notNull(),
})
EOF
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='app/Providers/AuthProvider.ts'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("import { ServiceProvider, shareInertiaProps, AUTH_CONTEXT_KEY } from '@guren/core'","import { ServiceProvider, shareInertiaProps, AUTH_CONTEXT_KEY, DatabaseApiTokenStore } from '@guren/core'")
s=s.replace("import { User } from '../Models/User.js'","import { apiTokens } from '../../db/schema.js'\nimport { User } from '../Models/User.js'")
s=s.replace("      credentialsPasswordField: 'password',\n    })\n","      credentialsPasswordField: 'password',\n    })\n    // Bearer store for the /mcp endpoint; the token's user is loaded through the `users` provider.\n    auth.useTokens(new DatabaseApiTokenStore(apiTokens), { provider: 'users' })\n",1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='src/app.ts'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("import { registerWebRoutes }","import { mcpPlugin } from '@guren/plugin-mcp'\nimport { registerWebRoutes }")
s=s.replace("providers: [AuthProvider, AuthorizationProvider]","providers: [AuthProvider, AuthorizationProvider, mcpPlugin({ serverInfo: { name: 'blog', version: '1.0.0' } })]")
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='routes/web.ts'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("""      authed.post('/', { name: 'posts.store', body: PostPayloadSchema }, [PostController, 'store'])""","""      authed.post('/', {
        name: 'posts.store',
        body: PostPayloadSchema,
        agent: { toolName: 'posts_store', description: 'Create a blog post authored by the calling user.' },
      }, [PostController, 'store'])""")
s=s.replace("""      body: PostSearchSchema,
""","""      body: PostSearchSchema,
      agent: {
        toolName: 'posts_search',
        readOnlyHint: true,
        description: 'Search published posts by keywords matched against title and excerpt.',
      },
""")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
bunx guren make:migration api_tokens 2>&1 | tail -5; bunx guren codegen 2>&1 | tail -3; bunx guren tool:list; bunx guren check 2>&1 | tail -30

sed -i.bak "s|expect(stored.status).toBe(200)|console.log(await stored.clone().text()); expect(stored.status).toBe(200)|" tests/McpEndpoint.test.ts; bun test tests/McpEndpoint.test.ts 2>&1 | grep -A6 "event: message" | head -20; mv tests/McpEndpoint.test.ts.bak /tmp/x.bak

result:
`bunx guren gate` now passes all six stages, including the `check` warning that was failing it.

I added `resource: PostResource` to the `posts.store` route in `routes/web.ts`. That hint alone would have been wrong, since `store` answered with a redirect. So `PostController.store` now returns the created post as JSON with status 201 when the request sends `Accept: application/json` and no `X-Inertia` header. Browsers and Inertia form posts still get the redirect.

I didn't check what `posts_store` returns over MCP after this change. The tests only confirm the post is created and validation errors still come back.
